title: console mobile (≤ 640 px): list as card rows with view chips and a FAB, the record page with a compact header, sticky tabs and a bottom action bar, related records pushed as full pages with a path row and back — the record is always a page on a phone
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_637faf9ef5c84d1bab00007c255c1861

Part of the record-page epic #26676 — the v4 record page on a phone. Target rewritten in full on 2026-10-31 against the canvas-60 `RecordMobile` board, on the maintainer's ruling (2026-10-31, verbatim): 「按画布 60 的 RecordMobile 板重写 #27058 的 Target，保持 pm:queue」. Design: evidence branch `claude/record-page-v2-evidence-20261027b` @ `a7825499aa`, folder `docs/design/record-page-v2-2026-10-27/v4/` — `RecordMobile.dc.html` (390 px, three frames: the list · the record page · one level down) and `notes.md` n46–n51 (n47 the top bar, n48 the stack below 760 px, n50 the tab row, n51 the HotCRM audit). Read with `git show a7825499aa:<path>`; never merge that branch. The board was drawn before n47 / n50 and is read through them: its view-tab chip row is superseded by #27594 (the title is the view switcher), its 「‹ Mira Costa ↑ ↓ ⋯」 line is the v4 top bar, and its record body is the < 760 px stack of #27524 item 6.

**The phone is not a separate design.** It is the v4 record (#27524) in a container narrower than 760 px, with three things only a phone adds: the record is always a page, the business actions sit in a bottom bar, and a related record is pushed as a page with a path row. This card therefore runs after #27524 ③ (the tab row, items 8–9) and ④ (the top bar, item 7) are on `main`: the components it extends do not exist before that, and the seats should not claim it until both are merged. It stays `pm:queue` on the maintainer's word; no `pm:blocked`.

## Source (origin/main `a0f865491d`, 2026-10-31, measured)

- **List on a phone** (viewport < 768, `useIsMobile`): `ObjectGrid` draws card rows titled by the declared name field (#26896 / objectui#13150); the list page header is hidden below `sm` (`ObjectView.tsx` 「Mobile: hide the entire PageHeader」); the view switcher is a 「<view> ▾」 dropdown the `AppHeader` draws from `MobileViewSwitcherContext` — the #27594 title switcher (`objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`) is desktop-only and 「ignores this context entirely」; 新建 is the FAB `mobile-fab-create` (`sm:hidden fixed right-4 bottom-36`). No bottom nav exists in `app-shell/src/layout` (the FAB comment names one; none is drawn).
- **Record on a phone**: the console calls `deriveRecordSurface(objectDef)` with no `viewport` option (`console/AppContent.tsx`), so the spec rule `if (opts.viewport === 'mobile') return 'page'` (`packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts`) never fires. The record opens in the `ObjectView` pane (#27545): a content area under `RECORD_SPLIT_MIN_CONTENT_PX` (1000) falls back to the drawer face, and below `sm` the drawer is `w-screen max-w-none` — a full-screen sheet over the list, with the pane's bar on top. `recordPageTierFor` answers `tabs` for any embedded page and for any width under 760, so the body is the 详情 / 相关 N / 时间线 segmented tier (the #27524 ② stack, PR #28116, is not merged yet). A related row opens one level down in the drawer stack (#26679), the bar's ← path.
- **Related lists on a phone** render as `object-gallery` cards (`RelatedList.tsx`: 「Mobile: render grid/table data as a card gallery」), title field + the next three columns.
- **Full page** (an object that declares `page`, or ↗ / ⋯ from the pane): a crumb row above the body with the ‹ origin link read from the `?from=` trail (`decodeRecordTrail`, `RecordDetailView.tsx` 「the top bar draws no record crumb (objectui#12461)」), `PageHeaderActions` in the header, actions wrapping.

## Target (canvas 60 `RecordMobile`; #27524 items 6–12 and #27594 apply unchanged, this card only says what the phone adds)

1. **The record is always a page on a phone.** The console passes `viewport: 'mobile'` to `deriveRecordSurface` when `useIsMobile()` is true, so the spec's own rule answers `page`: a list row tap navigates to the record route (the `?from=` trail carries the list context), the pane (split / drawer) is never mounted, and the reader's `recordOpen` preference (split / drawer / page) and the ⊟ switch do not apply. No metadata key; the spec already declares the rule and the console enforces it.
2. **List** (container < 760 px): the card rows stay (declared name field as the title, one subtitle line from the first two shown columns, one status chip); the list title is the #27594 switcher 「<view> ▾ · N」 on the phone too — the page header's title row is drawn below `sm`, with the filter / sort / display icons on its right, and the `AppHeader`'s `MobileViewSwitcherContext` dropdown retires (one switcher, as #27594 item 5 says: 「nothing else is special-cased」); the filter / sort chips keep one row with the count at the right; 新建 stays the FAB; the Display menu drops the layout row on the phone.
3. **Top bar** (#27524 item 7, compressed to 390 px): left, one link 「‹ <object plural label>」 — the breadcrumb's object half; the record name is the header title directly below and is not repeated. Right: the counter 「3 / 21」 and ↓ ↑, drawn only when the page arrived with a `?from=` list trail. No ⊟ (the stack has no right column), no ⤢ / ⤡, no ✕.
4. **Header**: avatar / initials, the name, the object chip; a subtitle line from the first two declared `highlightFields` that are text (the board: 「Atlas Construction · Director of Sales」); then the remaining declared highlights minus the name in two columns, at most four on the phone (#27524 item 12's rule, narrowed by width; the rest are in the sections anyway); the stage path compressed to one bar with its labels (「✓ 新建 已联系 已确认 已转化」). No header action row on the phone (item 6 below owns the actions).
5. **Tab row and enlarged state** (#27524 items 8–9, unchanged): 「概览 · 动态 N · <related> N · +N ▾」 at the bottom edge of the header block, the visible count computed from the 390 px row (概览 and at least one more always visible, the active tab always visible); a tab's enlarged state is the active tab, URL `?related=object.field`, and on the phone it fills the body with the child object's card rows (the related list's phone face), not a wide table; Esc / 概览 returns.
6. **Body = the < 760 px stack** (#27524 item 6, unchanged): the details sections (frameless, fields in two columns, 「显示 N 个空字段」 per section, the authored collapsed groups folded to one line 「地址 · 转化 · 附加信息 3 个空分区」), then the 动态 panel (one-line composer, the newest 3, 「查看全部 N 条 →」 opens the 动态 tab), then the related panels in `record.related.arrangement` order (compact rows, count chip, header tap = tab), the empty panels folded into 「还有 N 个空关联 · … · 展开」. The arrangement's `order` / `hidden` apply on the phone; nothing else is remembered.
7. **Bottom action bar**: the primary action, one secondary and ⋯ (the page's declared order, the same cap as the desktop header row: 1 + 2 + ⋯, the second secondary folding into ⋯ at 390 px) fixed at the bottom above the safe area (the board: 「转化线索 记录通话 ⋯」 on the lead, 「标记完成 改期 ⋯」 on the task); the body scrolls under it (`scroll-pb` for the bar's height); the FAB is not drawn on a record page.
8. **One level down**: a related row or a lookup opens the record as a page pushed over the current one (route navigation with the `?from=` trail extended; no drawer stack on a phone); a path row under the top bar 「线索 Mira Costa › 任务」 is the trail, each segment a link; 「‹」 returns to the parent and restores its scroll position (the related panel it came from); ↓ ↑ step through the same sibling set the desktop stack steps through — the parent's related rows for that list. The board's note, verbatim: 「手机上没有抽屉：关联记录整页推入，‹ 返回到线索并停在原滚动位置（关联面板处）；↑↓ 在同一层的兄弟（Mira 的 2 条任务）里翻；路径行就是桌面抽屉里的 ← 路径。」
9. No new metadata key; no new reader preference; ⛔ `packages/spec/**` (the `viewport` option already exists); ⛔ the pane's split / overlay / maximize mechanics (#27545) — the phone never mounts them.

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`, `objectViewRecordLinks.ts`, `console/AppContent.tsx` (`viewport: 'mobile'` → page; no pane on a phone), `objectViewPageHeader.tsx` (the title switcher below `sm`), `layout/AppHeader.tsx` + `layout/MobileViewSwitcherContext.tsx` (the channel retires), `views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (phone header, top bar left link, path row, bottom action bar, no header action row), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx` + `synth/recordPageColumns.ts` (the stack tier from #27524 ② is shared; the phone reads the container width like any face), the tab-row component #27524 ③ adds (the 390 px count), `RelatedList.tsx` (the enlarged tab's phone face), `ui/packages/components` for a bottom action bar primitive only if none exists, i18n in all ten packs, tests beside, changeset. ⛔ `packages/spec/**`; ⛔ `navigation-overlay.tsx` / `recordDrawerStack.tsx` beyond not mounting them on a phone.

## Acceptance

1. Tests (jsdom, `matchMedia` mobile + a 390 px container): a list row tap navigates to the record route and mounts no pane; the title switcher is drawn below `sm` and `AppHeader` draws no view dropdown; the record page draws the top bar's left link and, with a `?from=` trail, the counter and ↓ ↑; the tab row shows 概览 + 动态 + at least one related tab + 「+N ▾」 at 390 px; the body order is sections → 动态 → related → empty fold; the bottom action bar holds the primary action and ⋯ and no header action row exists; a related row tap pushes the page with the path row; 「‹」 returns to the parent.
2. Screenshots at 390 × 844 (Chromium mobile emulation) on `examples/app-crm` (the accepted preview surface under #26676 ruling B): the lead list, the lead record (header, tab row, stack, action bar), lead → task with the path row, and the 任务 tab active — on a never-merged evidence branch, linked from the PR body.
3. The #26896 card-view pins, the #27594 switcher pins and the #27524 tier / tab-row / top-bar pins are updated to the phone face, not deleted; the `MobileViewSwitcherContext` tests retire with the channel.
4. The epic seat re-checks the landed face on `main` against the board (maintainer, 2026-10-30: 「你可以自主验收合并，有问题会开新卡」).

## Rulings (maintainer, chat in the filing session, 2026-10-28 — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. Record-page model (2026-10-27): 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the resident timeline column: 「时间线是不是太突出了，这个只适合部分对象吧？适合做所有业务对象的默认布局吗」 and then 「时间线是否显示，是否可以切换，比如当前版本的 Claude code，顶部有很多切换图标」 — the column's presence is a per-user toggle with an object-derived default, never metadata.
3. On the related column's cost: 「关联都放在右侧，记录打开时是不是会很慢，因为需要加载所有的关联子表。」 — the related column loads counts first, rows on demand, and never blocks the details.
4. On mobile: 「还要考虑手机端的效果。」
5. On the definition surfaces: the PM's keep / narrow / retire table was put to the maintainer (keep object roles, relationship flags, six slotted slots and `kind: full`; retire the `tabs` slot and the dead `BuildPageOptions` hints; fold the quick-look path into the one record page) and approved with the instruction in the footer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 under epic #26676 (record page v2 → v3), from the record-page definition-surface inventory on objectstack main `7bb8084590` and the maintainer's rulings in that session. The maintainer's instruction to file and dispatch, verbatim: 「同意，以上界面相关的需要我确认的你负责立卡派发，如果有可能可以启动云会话，开发完你来确认。」 Design evidence: the design canvas boards 「记录页 v3」 row (RecordPageV3, RecordPageV3NoTimeline, RecordPageRef, RecordDrawerV3, RecordMobile) — exported to the never-merged branch named in the epic parent once this batch is filed.</sub>

<sub>Rewritten by the epic PM session `session_637faf9e-f5c8-4d1b-ab00-007c255c1861` on 2026-10-31 against the canvas-60 `RecordMobile` board (evidence `a7825499aa`), on the maintainer's ruling quoted at the top; the earlier Target (v3: sticky 详情 / 时间线 / 关联 tabs, a view-tab chip row) is superseded in full. Rulings 2 and 3 above were later settled by the v4 定稿 on #27524 (动态 is a panel and a tab, never a column; counts first) and are kept here as the record of the filing session.</sub>
